svg.aria-label: Tech Stack. IA & Automação: Claude API, OpenAI API, RAG, LangChain, n8n, Webhooks. Front-end: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Three.js. Back-end & Dados: Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Prisma, REST. Infra & Entrega: Vercel, AWS, Docker, Git & GitHub, CI/CD, Cloudflare. UI/UX: Figma, Design System, Acessibilidade, Responsivo.
